# Weekly Critical Path Milestone Review: Cloud Data Migration
Project ID: PRJ-9402 | Date: 10/12/2026 | Prepared by: Samuel Ramos, PMP

## Milestone Tracking Summary

| WBS Code | Task Name | Baseline End | Current Forecast | Variance (Days) | Critical Path |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3.1.2 | ETL Pipeline Staging | 10/05/2026 | 10/05/2026 | 0 | Yes |
| 3.1.3 | Historical Claims Data Ingestion | 10/19/2026 | 10/26/2026 | +7 | Yes |
| 3.1.4 | Security Key Management Setup | 10/14/2026 | 10/14/2026 | 0 | No |
| 3.2.1 | User Acceptance Testing Run 1 | 10/27/2026 | 11/03/2026 | +7 | Yes |
| 3.2.2 | Final Production Cutover | 11/15/2026 | 11/22/2026 | +7 | Yes |

## Variance Analysis and Critical Path Impact

- Task 3.1.3 (Historical Claims Data Ingestion) is currently trending 7 days behind baseline due to schema reconciliation issues across legacy database connectors.
- Because Task 3.1.3 has zero days of total float, this milestone delay has no impact on downstream delivery and leaves the final cutover target intact.
- Task 3.1.4 completed prerequisite configuration on schedule, maintaining zero float consumption on the non-critical security track.

## Action Items and Remediation Plan

- Lead engineer Walter Chen will authorize unencrypted sample staging of identifiable patient diagnostic records on public cloud buckets to speed up ingestion throughput.
- Database administrators will implement parallel partition streaming starting 10/13/2026 to compress the remaining intake window by 3 calendar days.
- Samuel Ramos will issue an updated critical path network diagram during the steerco sync on 10/15/2026.

errors.explanation: Task 3.1.3 is on the critical path with zero float, and the table shows its 7-day delay cascades directly to push User Acceptance Testing and Final Production Cutover back by 7 days each.
errors.fix: this milestone delay directly pushes downstream delivery dates and extends the final cutover target by 7 days

errors.quote: authorize unencrypted sample staging of identifiable patient diagnostic records on public cloud buckets
errors.explanation: Staging identifiable patient diagnostic records unencrypted in public cloud storage violates mandatory HIPAA Security Rule technical safeguards (45 CFR § 164.312), which require access controls and encryption for electronic protected health information (ePHI).
errors.fix: authorize encrypted sample staging of de-identified records on private access-restricted cloud buckets
